about_the_game:
ASTEROIDS is a modern reinterpretation of the Atari classic Asteroids (7800 version).

This game isn't a simple remake: it's a tribute to an era when scoring was the player's only claim to fame.

You pilot a ship alone against all, in an endless asteroid field, where every second of survival is a victory.

⚔️ Demanding, precise, and fast-paced gameplay.

🔓 Unlock achievements, bonuses, and hidden extras.

💾 Automatic saving of your progress and achievements.

💥 Retro yet intense visual and sound effects.

Every run is unique. Every explosion counts.

And only true survivors will achieve the ultimate score.

----------------------------

Fixed 4:3 resolution (gameplay choice for speed and precision)

Integrated achievement and reward system

Royalty-free electronic and synthwave music

AI-generated images and vector graphics

Progressive difficulty: from instant fun to hellish survival

Endless score mode

----------------------------

🎵 Music (Royalty-free YouTube)

Cyberpunk / Electronic Theme

Dark Arcade Synthwave

Epic Retro Space Theme

Neon Battle Theme

🔊 Sound effects

All from the royalty-free Mixkit Game Sounds library

----------------------------

Developed with Python / Pygame

Windows 10 / 11 compatible

Game size: ~340 MB

Keyboard and Xbox controller controls

No Python installation required (version packaged as .exe)

Game only French but very small text
